items.title: Nimble enters the item-tracking market with eco-friendly luggage tags and keychains
items.summary: As Google takes on Apple in the item-tracking market, Nimble is hoping its trackable wallets, keychains, luggage tags, and passport covers stand out.
items.creator: Lauren Forristal
